providers.tooltip.autoSwitch: When no enabled official backup account has primary quota remaining, automatically switch to this Provider. Only one Provider can be selected.
providers.tooltip.autoSwitchEnabled: Selected as the automatic fallback Provider. Click to disable.
providers.modal.description: Enter a provider or relay URL and API key. Models and relay platform are detected automatically.
providers.import.title: Confirm provider import
providers.import.description: Review these details. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
providers.import.name: Provider name
providers.import.duplicateHint: If this name already exists, a number will be added automatically.
providers.import.loadFailed: The import details could not be opened. Please try the link again.
providers.import.cancelFailed: The import could not be cancelled. Please try again.
providers.import.failed: The Provider could not be imported. Make sure the service is available and try again.
providers.presets.title: Add model preset
providers.presets.description: Choose a supported preset. Connection details and supported capabilities are filled in for you.
providers.presets.antigravityDescription: Connect to a ready local service and load its available models.
providers.presets.claudeCodeDescription: Anthropic's official API with automatic Claude model discovery.
providers.presets.deepSeekDescription: Official API with automatic model discovery and balance queries.
providers.presets.grokDescription: Official xAI Responses API with automatic model discovery.
providers.catalog.modelsNeedKey: Enter the API key before fetching models.
providers.catalog.modelsAutoHint: Models are fetched automatically when the connection is ready. You can also enter them manually.
providers.catalog.modelsStaticHint: Common models are prefilled. You can add or remove model names manually.
providers.catalog.openRouter.description: Use multiple model providers through one OpenRouter connection.
providers.catalog.openRouter.note: Only text models that support tool calling are included when models are fetched.
providers.catalog.kimi.description: Connect to Moonshot AI's official Kimi API.
providers.catalog.kimi.note: Tool-call reasoning is preserved across multi-step Codex requests.
providers.catalog.gemini.description: Use Gemini through Google's official OpenAI-compatible API.
providers.catalog.gemini.note: Gemini thought signatures are preserved automatically during tool calls.
providers.catalog.bailian.description: Connect to Alibaba Cloud Model Studio or its Coding Plan endpoints.
providers.catalog.bailian.note: Choose the endpoint that matches your account region and billing plan.
providers.catalog.ollama.description: Use models served by Ollama on this computer.
providers.catalog.ollama.note: The address must be a local HTTP loopback URL ending in /v1.
providers.catalog.lmStudio.description: Use models served locally by LM Studio.
providers.catalog.lmStudio.note: Use a local HTTP loopback URL ending in /v1. An access token is optional.
providers.catalog.glm.description: Connect to Zhipu AI's GLM standard API or Coding Plan.
providers.catalog.glm.note: Choose the endpoint for your account region, then adjust the available models if needed.
providers.catalog.miniMax.note: The China and international endpoints use separate accounts and API keys.
providers.catalog.mistral.description: Use Devstral, Codestral, and other models through Mistral's official API.
providers.catalog.mistral.note: Fetched models are limited to active chat models that support function calling.
providers.catalog.volcengine.description: Connect to Volcengine ModelArk or BytePlus ModelArk.
providers.catalog.volcengine.note: Enter the model or endpoint ID created in the matching ModelArk region.
providers.antigravity.description: Use models from your Google Antigravity-compatible local service in Codex.
providers.antigravity.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank for the default local service
providers.antigravity.modelsUpdated: Loaded {count} available models from Google Antigravity.
providers.antigravity.modelsHint: Common models are ready to use. Load models to sync with the running service.
providers.antigravity.gatewayHint: Start your Codex-compatible Antigravity service on port 51122 before switching to this preset.
providers.claudeCode.description: Use Claude models in Codex through Anthropic's official API.
providers.claudeCode.modelsNeedKey: Enter the Anthropic API key before fetching models.
providers.claudeCode.modelsAutoHint: Models load after the API key is ready. You can also enter one manually.
providers.claudeCode.reasoningHint: Claude manages thinking because the compatibility layer ignores Codex effort choices.
providers.claudeCode.billingHint: Claude subscriptions and API billing are separate. Charges follow your Anthropic Console account.
providers.grok.description: Connect Codex directly to Grok through xAI's official Responses API.
providers.grok.modelsNeedKey: Enter the xAI API key before fetching models.
providers.grok.modelsUpdated: Loaded {count} available language models from xAI.
providers.grok.modelsAutoHint: Models load after the API key is ready. You can also enter one manually.
providers.grok.billingHint: Model access and billing follow your xAI account.
providers.deepSeek.description: Connect DeepSeek through the local proxy. Available models are loaded from the official API and work with Codex requests.
providers.deepSeek.modelsNeedKey: Enter the API key before fetching models.
providers.deepSeek.modelsAutoHint: The latest models are fetched automatically after the API key is ready. You can also keep a manually entered model.
providers.deepSeek.contextHint: The preset uses a 1M context window by default. Adjust it if DeepSeek changes the selected model limit.
providers.deepSeek.balanceHint: Balance is queried automatically through DeepSeek's official service.
providers.deepSeek.imageInputUnsupported: DeepSeek V4 accepts text only, so image input stays off.
providers.openai.description: Connect to an upstream Remote AI. Models and context limits follow the upstream official Codex catalog.
providers.openai.baseUrlHint: Enter the upstream Remote AI API address, usually ending in /v1.
providers.openai.apiKeyPlaceholder: Leave blank when authentication is not required
providers.form.name: Name
providers.form.modelsNeedConnection: Enter the provider URL and API key before fetching models.
providers.form.modelsFetchFailed: Could not fetch models. Check the URL and API key, then try again.
providers.form.modelsAutoHint: Models are fetched automatically when the connection is ready. You can also edit them manually.
providers.form.modelsRefreshHint: Fetch the latest models, or edit the list manually.
providers.form.modelRowsHint: Configure each model's reasoning, context length, API protocol, image input support, and optional cost per 1M tokens.
providers.form.modelsPlaceholder: Type a model and press Enter
providers.form.contextWindowHint: Choose a common value or enter your own. Leave blank to use 256K.
providers.advanced.title: Advanced settings
providers.advanced.fullUrlHint: For a complete endpoint address. Enter model names manually in this mode.
providers.advanced.hint: Only fill these in when your provider requires them. Use the API key field for credentials.
providers.advanced.invalidJson: Enter a valid JSON object, or leave the field empty.
providers.advanced.invalidHeaders: Check header names and values. Authentication headers are managed separately.
providers.advanced.reservedBody: Additional parameters cannot replace the model, messages, tools or credentials.
providers.advanced.tooLarge: These settings are too long. Shorten them and try again.
providers.advanced.tooDeep: Simplify the nested parameters and try again.
providers.form.supportsFastModeHint: Use the Normal / Fast switch at the top of the page. Clear this option if the API does not support Fast mode.
providers.form.keepApiKey: Leave blank to keep saved key
providers.form.platformAwaitingConnectio: Enter the provider URL and API key to detect the relay platform.
providers.form.platformNotDetected: No supported relay platform was detected. Balance queries remain disabled.
providers.form.balanceReuseApiKeyHint: Turn off only when the balance endpoint uses a different token.
providers.form.keepBalanceToken: Leave blank to keep the saved query token
providers.form.keepWalletToken: Leave blank to keep the saved wallet token
providers.form.walletTokenHint: Optional. Sub2API uses a dashboard JWT.
providers.form.walletNewApiTokenAutoIdHi: The matching user ID is obtained automatically through wallet login. Token is tried first.
providers.form.walletLoginAlternative: Or log in with username and password
providers.form.keepWalletPassword: Leave blank to keep the saved password
providers.form.walletLoginHint: Optional. Used only to log in to New API and query the user wallet balance.
providers.group.manageDescription: Groups are shared with official accounts. Renaming or removing a group updates all its members.
providers.group.deleteDescription: Accounts and APIs will remain saved and become ungrouped.
